1a.speaker: Jamie
1a.en: Then, on June 6, 1991, the accident happened.

1b.speaker: Jamie
1b.en: A huge explosion struck Chernoton Laboratory. The cause was unknown. A germ weapon under development escaped into the air. It destroyed the nation and the project.
cards: A germ weapon under|development escaped into the air.
It destroyed the nation|and the project.

1d.speaker: Gillian
1d.en: That's impossible! I caused the Catastrophe?

1e.speaker: Jamie
1e.en: During the chaos of the Catastrophe, the American government miraculously rescued Dr. Petrovich and our son Harry.
cards: the American government|miraculously rescued Dr. Petrovich

1f.speaker: Jamie
1f.en: The three of us failed to escape: you, me and Elijah.
cards: The three of us failed|to escape: you, me and Elijah.

20.speaker: Jamie
20.en: We entered cold sleep in a shelter beneath the Kremlin, until the bacteria would become harmless.
cards: We entered cold sleep|in a shelter beneath the Kremlin,

21.speaker: Gillian
21.en: Fifty years later, three years ago, the 17th expedition found us.

22.speaker: Jamie
22.en: Elijah's pod was already empty when we were rescued.
cards: Elijah's pod was|already empty when we were rescued.

23.speaker: Gillian
23.en: Elijah Madnar? The man in the chapel? The one who looked like Randam?
cards: Elijah Madnar? The|man in the chapel?

25.speaker: Jamie
25.en: Elijah Madnar is here, with the Snatchers...
cards: Elijah Madnar is here,|with the Snatchers...

28.speaker: Madnar
28.en: It's been a long time, Jamie. And you, Gillian.
cards: It's been a long time,|Jamie. And you, Gillian.

2c.speaker: Madnar
2c.en: You remember me? I am Elijah Madnar, Petrovich Madnar's only son. Elijah himself. Though I've grown old and frail.
cards: I am Elijah Madnar,|Petrovich Madnar's only son.
Elijah himself. Though|I've grown old and frail.

2d.speaker: Jamie
2d.en: Elijah, why would you do this? Dr. Petrovich just died.
cards: Elijah, why would you|do this? Dr. Petrovich just died.

2e.speaker: Madnar
2e.en: What? My father? I see. My father is dead.
cards: What? My father? I see.|My father is dead.

2f.speaker: Jamie
2f.en: Elijah, what happened to you? You were never capable of anything like this.
cards: You were never capable|of anything like this.

30.speaker: Madnar
30.en: Forty years have changed me, too.

32.speaker: Madnar
32.en: Why make me say it, Jamie?

33.speaker: Madnar
33.en: It was all because of you, Jamie. Your beauty.
cards: It was all because of|you, Jamie. Your beauty.

34.speaker: Madnar
34.en: Fifty years ago in Moscow, I was obsessed. With my research, and with you, Jamie.
cards: Fifty years ago in|Moscow, I was obsessed.
With my research, and|with you, Jamie.

35.speaker: Madnar
35.en: I was still young, an electronics research student just starting out. My father's connections got me into the Snatcher Project. That's where I met you, Jamie. You were my father Petrovich's assistant.
cards: an electronics research|student just starting out.
My father's connections|got me into the Snatcher Project.

36.speaker: Madnar
36.en: Your beauty captivated me, Jamie. Your smile filled my heart. You had something the women of the East didn't.
cards: You had something the|women of the East didn't.

37.speaker: Madnar
37.en: I was young and withdrawn, but you slowly opened my heart. I couldn't stop my feelings.

39.speaker: Madnar
39.en: I was happy. Despite all the political turmoil, every day was fulfilling. My father trusted me. Jamie watched over me. I worked desperately to complete my research.
cards: every day was|fulfilling. My father trusted me.
I worked desperately to|complete my research.

3a.speaker: Madnar
3a.en: But even that small happiness didn't last.
cards: But even that small|happiness didn't last.

3b.speaker: Madnar
3b.en: You appeared, Gillian. You came into our lives. And everything fell apart.
cards: You appeared, Gillian.|You came into our lives.

3d.speaker: Madnar
3d.en: Far from home, Jamie quickly grew close to Gillian, her fellow countryman.
cards: Far from home, Jamie|quickly grew close to Gillian,

3e.speaker: Madnar
3e.en: All I could do was watch from the shadows as you two grew closer.
cards: from the shadows as you|two grew closer.

3f.speaker: Madnar
3f.en: You and Jamie fell in love, married and had a child.
cards: You and Jamie fell in|love, married and had a child.

41.speaker: Madnar
41.en: Even so, my feelings only grew stronger. My father worried about me. He tried to take me off the project, but I wouldn't let go.
cards: Even so, my feelings|only grew stronger.
He tried to take me off|the project, but I wouldn't let go.

42.speaker: Madnar
42.en: I wanted to be near you, Jamie.
cards: I wanted to be near|you, Jamie.

43.speaker: Madnar
43.en: That year, the wave of democracy that swept Eastern Europe spread throughout our country.
cards: That year, the wave of|democracy that swept

44.speaker: Madnar
44.en: The Cold War between East and West ended. The conservatives behind the project lost power. The Frankenstein Project was canceled.
cards: The Cold War between|East and West ended.
The conservatives|behind the project lost power.

45.speaker: Madnar
45.en: The reformist leaders wanted to hide this insane project. They ordered us to dispose of all our research materials. Then they planned to put us on trial.
cards: The reformist leaders|wanted to hide this insane project.
Then they planned to|put us on trial.

46.speaker: Madnar
46.en: You and Gillian were to be sent back to your country.
cards: You and Gillian were to|be sent back to your country.

47.speaker: Madnar
47.en: That's when I learned you were a CIA agent, Gillian. And you, Gillian, were planning to secretly hand our research over to your country's military. It was a cash deal with your government.
cards: That's when I learned|you were a CIA agent, Gillian.
And you, Gillian, were|planning to secretly hand
our research over to|your country's military.
It was a cash deal with|your government.

48.speaker: Madnar
48.en: I wasn't a politician. I didn't care what happened to the state. My research and Jamie were my whole world.
cards: I didn't care what|happened to the state.
My research and Jamie|were my whole world.

49.speaker: Madnar
49.en: I was about to lose it all. You can't imagine the shock that was to a young man.
cards: I was about to lose it|all.
You can't imagine the|shock that was to a young man.

4b.speaker: Madnar
4b.en: That's when I decided to carry out the insane plan I'd been developing in secret.
cards: to carry out the insane|plan I'd been developing in secret.

4c.speaker: Madnar
4c.en: The bioroids were 80 percent complete. The core endoskeleton was nearly finished. but the artificial skin was not. That was my work, and Jamie's.

4d.speaker: Madnar
4d.en: Artificial skin didn't need T lymphocytes, Langerhans cells or endocrine cells. We needed keratinocytes and pigment cells: melanocytes.
cards: We needed keratinocytes|and pigment cells: melanocytes.

4e.speaker: Madnar
4e.en: Artificial protein technology was too limited back then. Synthesizing real cells was extremely difficult. Research like that took years.

4f.speaker: Madnar
4f.en: The original plan was to Snatch an entire country at once. We had to replace a whole nation or city in a single night.
cards: to Snatch an entire|country at once.
We had to replace a|whole nation

50.speaker: Madnar
50.en: So another team was developing a germ weapon alongside the Snatchers. Reliable and fast-acting, able to kill an entire population in an instant.
cards: able to kill an entire|population in an instant.

52.speaker: Madnar
52.en: Exactly. The RA011 virus, developed by another team.
cards: Exactly. The RA011|virus, developed by another team.

53.speaker: Madnar
53.en: As an insider, I could easily blow up the laboratory.
cards: As an insider, I could|easily blow up the laboratory.

54.speaker: Jamie
54.en: How could you? Half the world died because of you!
cards: How could you? Half the|world died because of you!

55.speaker: Madnar
55.en: On June 6, I acted, after moving the bioroid research materials and records into the shelter.
cards: On June 6, I acted,|after moving the bioroid
research materials and|records into the shelter.

56.speaker: Madnar
56.en: After I sealed off the institute, I entered cold sleep in an underground shelter with you two, who had failed to escape. I left a satellite to monitor the atmosphere. We would wake automatically when Lucifer Alpha became harmless.
cards: I entered cold sleep in|an underground shelter
with you two, who had|failed to escape.
I left a satellite to|monitor the atmosphere.

57.speaker: Madnar
57.en: After ten years, Lucifer mutated naturally.

58.speaker: Jamie
58.en: But the automatic revival system didn't work.
cards: But the automatic|revival system didn't work.

59.speaker: Madnar
59.en: No, it worked. I woke exactly ten years later. Before you two, Gillian.
cards: No, it worked. I woke|exactly ten years later.

5a.speaker: Gillian
5a.en: Even sealed off, how did you avoid infection?
cards: Even sealed off, how|did you avoid infection?

5b.speaker: Madnar
5b.en: The vaccine, L-Angels, was already complete.

5d.speaker: Madnar
5d.en: Everything went according to plan. My real struggle began afterward.

5e.speaker: Madnar
5e.en: I planned to wake only Jamie, so we could finish the bioroids together. You would sleep forever, Gillian.
cards: so we could finish the|bioroids together.

5f.speaker: Madnar
5f.en: But I couldn't do it. Not with Jamie sleeping so peacefully.

60.speaker: Madnar
60.en: And back then, I couldn't have persuaded Jamie. It wasn't time yet. I reset your timers to infinity.
cards: And back then, I|couldn't have persuaded Jamie.
It wasn't time yet. I|reset your timers to infinity.

62.speaker: Madnar
62.en: For forty years, I worked alone in the darkness beneath the Kremlin, developing the bioroids' artificial skin.
cards: I worked alone in the|darkness beneath the Kremlin,

63.speaker: Madnar
63.en: Day after day, no visitors. No sunlight. No changing colors of the seasons.
cards: Day after day, no|visitors. No sunlight.

64.speaker: Madnar
64.en: But Jamie was always sleeping beside me. I spoke to you for forty years, in that dark underground shelter.
cards: But Jamie was always|sleeping beside me.
I spoke to you for|forty years,

66.speaker: Madnar
66.en: Three years ago, I finally completed my research.
cards: Three years ago, I|finally completed my research.

67.speaker: Madnar
67.en: First, I Snatched the Siberian search team to secure a route for transporting the bioroids.
cards: First, I Snatched the|Siberian search team
to secure a route for|transporting the bioroids.

68.speaker: Madnar
68.en: I chose Neo Kobe City as my first test of the Snatchers.
cards: I chose Neo Kobe City|as my first test of the Snatchers.

69.speaker: Madnar
69.en: Neo Kobe was cut off from the outside world. Ideal for simulating a miniature nation. Its mix of ethnic groups also made it ideal for gathering a wide range of data on Snatching.
cards: Neo Kobe was cut off|from the outside world.
Its mix of ethnic|groups also made it ideal
for gathering a wide|range of data on Snatching.

6a.speaker: Madnar
6a.en: Another reason was Japanese culture itself, with its deep suspicion of others.

6b.speaker: Madnar
6b.en: But the test exposed a flaw in the artificial skin.
cards: But the test exposed a|flaw in the artificial skin.

6c.speaker: Madnar
6c.en: It was completely unexpected. I'd spent forty years on that research.
cards: I'd spent forty years|on that research.

6d.speaker: Madnar
6d.en: I gathered data and tried to find a solution. But nothing worked.
cards: I gathered data and|tried to find a solution.

6e.speaker: Jamie
6e.en: So that's why you brought Dr. Petrovich here.
cards: So that's why you|brought Dr. Petrovich here.

6f.speaker: Madnar
6f.en: Yes. I found my father in a state hospital. He was old, but his mind was sharp.
cards: Yes. I found my father|in a state hospital.
He was old, but his|mind was sharp.

70.speaker: Madnar
70.en: Of course, my father refused to help.
cards: Of course, my father|refused to help.

71.speaker: Jamie
71.en: Of course he refused. The doctor would never...
cards: Of course he refused.|The doctor would never...

72.speaker: Madnar
72.en: Without my father's help, I decided to wake you.
cards: Without my father's|help, I decided to wake you.

73.speaker: Madnar
73.en: But a mistake put both you and Gillian in the government's hands.

74.speaker: Gillian
74.en: What are you planning? This won't bring Jamie back!

75.speaker: Madnar
75.en: I'm simply exploring what it means to be human. Jamie may have inspired me once, but not anymore.
cards: I'm simply exploring|what it means to be human.
Jamie may have inspired|me once, but not anymore.

76.speaker: Gillian
76.en: Isn't that just a scientist's arrogance?

77.speaker: Madnar
77.en: Humans are fragile. Even the strongest trust crumbles under the slightest doubt.

78.speaker: Madnar
78.en: Look how the Snatchers have shaken humanity. For all our scientific progress and lofty ideals, we still doubt, hate and kill each other.
cards: Look how the Snatchers|have shaken humanity.
For all our scientific|progress and lofty ideals,
we still doubt, hate|and kill each other.

79.speaker: Madnar
79.en: Snatchers are merely tools that bring that out.
cards: Snatchers are merely|tools that bring that out.

7a.speaker: Madnar
7a.en: Through them, I simply reveal what lies within us.
cards: Through them, I simply|reveal what lies within us.

7b.speaker: Madnar
7b.en: I think this experiment has shown me humanity's limits. Perhaps they can advance no further on their own.
cards: I think this experiment|has shown me humanity's limits.
Perhaps they can|advance no further on their own.

7c.speaker: Madnar
7c.en: To evolve further, humanity needs a perfect leader. A resolute leader, unmoved by petty doubts.
cards: To evolve further,|humanity needs a perfect leader.
A resolute leader,|unmoved by petty doubts.

7e.speaker: Madnar
7e.en: They will if they don't know what their leaders are. People have always sought an absolute god.
cards: They will if they don't|know what their leaders are.
People have always|sought an absolute god.

7f.speaker: Madnar
7f.en: Remove all doubt, and Snatchers can be their gods. A superior humanity made flesh.
cards: Remove all doubt, and|Snatchers can be their gods.

80.speaker: Madnar
80.en: I'm so close. Once the artificial skin is complete, Snatchers will surpass humanity and become true human beings.
cards: Once the artificial|skin is complete, Snatchers
will surpass humanity|and become true human beings.

81.speaker: Jamie
81.en: Perfect artificial skin is impossible. Dr. Petrovich is dead.

82.speaker: Madnar
82.en: I no longer need my father. I have a sample he made. Once I've analyzed it, I can mass-produce perfect artificial skin in any quantity I need.
cards: I no longer need my|father. I have a sample he made.
Once I've analyzed it,|I can mass-produce
perfect artificial skin|in any quantity I need.

83.speaker: Madnar
83.en: Or I can simply culture the necessary cells: keratinocytes, epithelial cells and pigment cells, then multiply them.
cards: Or I can simply culture|the necessary cells: keratinocytes,
epithelial cells and|pigment cells, then multiply them.

84.speaker: Gillian
84.en: What are you talking about? Where's this perfect skin?
cards: What are you talking|about? Where's this perfect skin?

86.speaker: Madnar
86.en: It was found in the ruins of Queen Hospital.
cards: It was found in the|ruins of Queen Hospital.

88.speaker: Madnar
88.en: Ah, so you do know him.
cards: Ah, so you do know him.

8a.speaker: Madnar
8a.en: That's not quite accurate. My father secretly built that bioroid in the likeness of his son. Me.
cards: in the likeness of his|son. Me.

8b.speaker: Madnar
8b.en: Here in this factory. He programmed it to destroy Snatchers.

8c.speaker: Madnar
8c.en: That bioroid gave me no end of trouble. It's far superior to my Snatchers.
cards: That bioroid gave me no|end of trouble.

8d.speaker: Madnar
8d.en: It believes it's human. He even gave it childhood memories. Ha! Copies of my memories, of course.
cards: It believes it's human.|He even gave it childhood memories.
Ha! Copies of my|memories, of course.

8f.speaker: Madnar
8f.en: Just like my father. That old fool easily made the skin I couldn't perfect in forty years. And a perfect bioroid that doesn't even know what it is.
cards: That old fool easily|made the skin
And a perfect bioroid|that doesn't even know what it is.

90.speaker: Madnar
90.en: What's more, these cells regenerate themselves. Supply them once, and there's no need for further grafts of their own skin, or cultures.
cards: Supply them once, and|there's no need
for further grafts of|their own skin, or cultures.

92.speaker: Madnar
92.en: Its power and main systems have shut down. It's just scrap. But I've kept the precious artificial skin alive.
cards: Its power and main|systems have shut down.
But I've kept the|precious artificial skin alive.

93.speaker: Madnar
93.en: Now I can begin phase two of the Snatch Project: full-scale infiltration of the world.
cards: Now I can begin phase|two of the Snatch Project:

94.speaker: Gillian
94.en: The summit's over. You won't get away with it.
cards: The summit's over.|You won't get away with it.

95.speaker: Madnar
95.en: What does the summit matter? With perfect skin, nothing will hold us back. We can go anywhere, and no one will know.
cards: With perfect skin,|nothing will hold us back.
We can go anywhere, and|no one will know.

96.speaker: Madnar
96.en: The world will obey me. No one can stop me now.
cards: The world will obey me.|No one can stop me now.

97.speaker: Madnar
97.en: Politics and ideology mean nothing. My will alone shall decide humanity's future.
cards: My will alone shall|decide humanity's future.

98.speaker: Gillian
98.en: You're insane! You can't Snatch all of humanity!
cards: You're insane! You|can't Snatch all of humanity!

99.speaker: Madnar
99.en: There's an automated Snatcher factory beneath the Kremlin. It's still producing new Snatchers.

9a.speaker: Jamie
9a.en: No matter what you do, you can't Snatch a human heart. What would any of this achieve?
cards: No matter what you do,|you can't Snatch a human heart.

9b.speaker: Madnar
9b.en: Humanity is foolish, Jamie. But I'm different. I'm the savior of humanity. No, of all life on Earth!
cards: Humanity is foolish,|Jamie. But I'm different.
I'm the savior of|humanity. No, of all life on Earth!

9e.speaker: Metal Gear
9e.en: In ten minutes, a particle beam will strike this church.
cards: a particle beam|will strike this church.

9f.speaker: Metal Gear
9f.en: I'm guiding a killer satellite's beam here with GPS and fifteen satellites. It won't miss.
cards: I'm guiding a|killer satellite's beam here
with GPS and|fifteen satellites. It won't miss.

a0.speaker: Metal Gear
a0.en: Everything within several kilometers of me will be destroyed.

a1.speaker: Madnar
a1.en: Stop this madness! You'll destroy my research! You inferior analyzer!
cards: Stop this madness!|You'll destroy my research!

a2.speaker: Gillian
a2.en: Metal, what did the summit decide?

a3.speaker: Metal Gear
a3.en: Fearing the spread of Snatchers, every nation's delegates unanimously authorized the use of nuclear weapons. The military is sealing off the city.
cards: The military is|sealing off the city.

a4.speaker: Jamie
a4.en: They're going to let the citizens die?
cards: They're going to let|the citizens die?

a5.speaker: Metal Gear
a5.en: The citizens are panicking. But if the beam destroys this place, the blockade will be lifted. This is our last chance.
cards: But if the beam|destroys this place,
the blockade will|be lifted. This is our last chance.

a6.speaker: Metal Gear
a6.en: I'll handle things here. Gillian, take Jamie and go.
cards: I'll handle things|here. Gillian, take Jamie and go.

a8.speaker: Metal Gear
a8.en: Move and I'll detonate! Hurry, Gillian!

aa.speaker: Metal Gear
aa.en: I won't let a single Snatcher escape! I'll destroy this artificial skin, too!
cards: I won't let a|single Snatcher escape!

ab.speaker: Madnar
ab.en: A piece of junk like you? If you're the beam's target, we'll just carry you outside!

ac.speaker: Madnar
ac.en: Get this runt out of here!

b2.speaker: Madnar
b2.en: How? You shouldn't be able to move!
cards: How? You shouldn't be|able to move!

b3.speaker: Randam
b3.en: I don't know when to quit.

b5.speaker: Randam
b5.en: You're dying with me. Don't fight it. Hey, Snatchers! Keep your hands off the little guy, or I'll snap his neck!
cards: You're dying with me.|Don't fight it. Hey, Snatchers!
Keep your hands off the|little guy, or I'll snap his neck!

b7.speaker: Randam
b7.en: I don't like being used. You and I will see the end together.
cards: You and I will see the|end together.

b8.speaker: Metal Gear
b8.en: Five minutes, Gillian. The Tricycle's waiting outside. Get in it.
cards: The Tricycle's|waiting outside. Get in it.

b9.speaker: Madnar
b9.en: Let go! I'm Elijah Madnar! You're a copy of me!
cards: Let go! I'm Elijah|Madnar! You're a copy of me!

ba.speaker: Randam
ba.en: Real or fake, we're both going to die here. Once we're both dead, there won't be a fake anymore.
cards: Real or fake, we're|both going to die here.
Once we're both dead,|there won't be a fake anymore.

bd.speaker: Madnar
bd.en: Machines have no will! They can't sacrifice themselves!
cards: Machines have no will!|They can't sacrifice themselves!

bf.speaker: Metal Gear
bf.en: Four minutes. Get out, now! Destroy the automated factory beneath the Kremlin.

c1.speaker: Randam
c1.en: Gillian! Even if the memories in my head were made up...
cards: Gillian! Even if the|memories in my head were made up...

c2.speaker: Gillian
c2.en: I know! Our memories of fighting together are real! There's no doubt about that!
cards: I know! Our memories|of fighting together are real!

c3.speaker: Randam
c3.en: You've become a fine JUNKER, Gillian.

c4.speaker: Metal Gear
c4.en: I enjoyed working with you, Gillian.

c6.speaker: Metal Gear
c6.en: If you can, recover my remains, like Little John's.
cards: If you can, recover|my remains, like Little John's.

c9.5.speaker: Gillian
c9.5.en: I'm sorry. Both of you! Let's go, Jamie!
cards: I'm sorry. Both of|you! Let's go, Jamie!

ca.5.speaker: Madnar
ca.5.en: No! Don't let her go! Jamie!

cb.4.speaker: Jamie
cb.4.en: I'm all right. They won't hurt me. At least, not until their work on perfect artificial skin is complete.
cards: I'm all right. They|won't hurt me.

cb.5.speaker: Randam
cb.5.en: Pathetic. You don't even know how to love someone.
cards: Pathetic. You don't|even know how to love someone.

cc.5.speaker: Madnar
cc.5.en: What are you laughing at, machine?!

cd.4.speaker: Jamie
cd.4.en: My memory's back. All of it.

cd.5.speaker: Randam
cd.5.en: By Snatching you, I'll take myself back.
cards: By Snatching you, I'll|take myself back.

ce.5.speaker: Metal Gear
ce.5.en: Under a minute, Randam. It's all right now. Thank you.
cards: Under a minute,|Randam. It's all right now.

cf.4.speaker: Jamie
cf.4.en: They threatened to kill him. To kill Harry. They forced me to help develop artificial skin.
cards: They threatened to kill|him. To kill Harry.
They forced me to help|develop artificial skin.

cf.5.speaker: Randam
cf.5.en: Don't thank me. Sorry I dragged you into such a big job.
cards: Don't thank me. Sorry I|dragged you into such a big job.

d0.4.speaker: Jamie
d0.4.en: The doctor's condition was getting worse, so they brought me here to take his place.
cards: so they brought me here|to take his place.

d0.5.speaker: Randam
d0.5.en: Well done. You're a fine JUNKER.

d1.4.speaker: Jamie
d1.4.en: Gillian, Harry the mechanic is our son. He's lived alone for fifty years.
cards: Gillian, Harry the|mechanic is our son.

d1.5.speaker: Metal Gear
d1.5.en: Three, two, one. Here it comes!

d3.4.speaker: Jamie
d3.4.en: I had no choice. They threatened me. But I can't go on.
cards: I had no choice. They|threatened me. But I can't go on.

d5.4.speaker: Jamie
d5.4.en: The doctor just died. He was over a hundred.
cards: The doctor just died.|He was over a hundred.

d7.4.speaker: Jamie
d7.4.en: Don't you remember Dr. Petrovich? Dr. Petrovich Madnar.
cards: Don't you remember Dr.|Petrovich? Dr. Petrovich Madnar.

d9.speaker: Jamie
d9.en: They'd apparently been held here for three years to develop artificial skin for the Snatchers. One was his own father.
cards: They'd apparently been|held here for three years
to develop artificial|skin for the Snatchers.

da.speaker: Gillian
da.en: Whose father? I don't understand. Jamie, you've lost me.
cards: Whose father? I don't|understand. Jamie, you've lost me.

dc.speaker: Gillian
dc.en: Tell me, Jamie. Who am I? What were we doing in the Kremlin?
cards: Who am I? What were|we doing in the Kremlin?

dd.speaker: Jamie
dd.en: All right, Gillian. I'll tell you about that terrible past.
cards: I'll tell you about|that terrible past.

de.speaker: Jamie
de.en: All right? Stay calm and listen.

df.speaker: Jamie
df.en: Fifty years ago, we worked on a top-secret project in the Soviet Union. The Cold War still divided East and West. Everyone lived in fear of nuclear war.
cards: on a top-secret project|in the Soviet Union.
The Cold War still|divided East and West.
Everyone lived in fear|of nuclear war.

e0.speaker: Jamie
e0.en: The world's military balance had reached its limit. It was a naive age. The great powers' leaders believed military force alone could make their nations stronger.
cards: The world's military|balance had reached its limit.
force alone could make|their nations stronger.

e1.speaker: Jamie
e1.en: A treaty to halt nuclear arms production was expected soon. Meanwhile, America and the other military powers were entering an arms race in space.
cards: powers were entering an|arms race in space.

e2.speaker: Jamie
e2.en: But the Kremlin's conservative tyrants thought differently. They sought military supremacy through a completely different approach.

e3.speaker: Jamie
e3.en: A plan more horrifying than anyone could imagine.
cards: A plan more horrifying|than anyone could imagine.

e4.speaker: Jamie
e4.en: The communist bloc was facing an economic crisis. Democratic and nationalist movements were rising. The survival of socialism was at stake.
cards: The communist bloc was|facing an economic crisis.
The survival of|socialism was at stake.

e5.speaker: Jamie
e5.en: The reformers were gaining ground. The Kremlin conservatives were desperate. So they launched that childish scheme.

e6.speaker: Gillian
e6.en: The Snatcher Project. Secretly replace enemy VIPs with Kremlin puppets. Control their politics and economies, and spread communism and socialism from within.
cards: Secretly replace|enemy VIPs with Kremlin puppets.
and spread communism|and socialism from within.

e8.speaker: Jamie
e8.en: They gathered brilliant scientists from around the world to develop the Snatchers. Some were brought there by force.

e9.speaker: Jamie
e9.en: At the top was our team: the Frankenstein Project team.

ea.speaker: Jamie
ea.en: Four scientists led by Dr. Petrovich Madnar, who lies here now.

eb.speaker: Jamie
eb.en: Dr. Petrovich Madnar, a robotics specialist. His son Elijah Madnar, genetic engineering and microbiology. My fields were nanobiology and picobiology. Gillian, behavioral physiology and psychopathology.

ec.speaker: Jamie
ec.en: Development began in Neo Akademgorodok, in Novosibirsk. Then it moved beneath the Kremlin.

ed.speaker: Jamie
ed.en: Perestroika and glasnost were fueling calls for democracy. So the conservatives hid us underground.

ee.speaker: Jamie
ee.en: The reformers joined forces with America to stop the project.

ef.speaker: Jamie
ef.en: You were an intelligence agent sent by the CIA, Gillian. Your mission was to sabotage the project.
cards: Your mission was to|sabotage the project.

f1.speaker: Jamie
f1.en: Our government must know about that. That's why they assigned you to JUNKER.
